svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V1 · The Plank — Docks (7)
svg.desc: Two layers: the square is the water cell (anchor engraved); the plank strip glues on top, flush with the island-facing edge, and overhangs onto the island by a third of a square. The overhang is what 'attaches' it. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
